conflicts.where: Lesson 5 (GB/TB example); repeated in Final Explanation Part 4(b) and Part 5 exemplar
conflicts.problem: Lesson 5 states 1 GB ≈ 2³⁰ bytes and then says 1 TB = (2¹⁰)³ = 2³⁰. This gives the same value for 1 GB and 1 TB. Since 1 TB = 1024 GB = 2¹⁰ × 2³⁰, 1 TB ≈ 2⁴⁰ bytes. (2¹⁰)³ = 2³⁰ is the size of 1 GB, not 1 TB, so the context is wrong. The lesson should use 1 GB = (2¹⁰)³ = 2³⁰ bytes, or 1 TB = 2⁴⁰ bytes.
